profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at EnterBridge
profile.summary: Engineer’s Degree, Computer Science. More than 7 years of experience in software development, specializing in C#, SQL Server, and API. Reliable team worker with a strong desire to reach and surpass new challenges. Ability to solve complex problems and learn new knowledge. It loves software development, professional growth, and a professional challenge.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-	Worked on development of a REST API, built with PHP.
-	Build Single Page Application using React JS.
-	Implemented component of an app that allows user to take a picture, edit it, and save it. It was built using Expo Camera.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Worked on design & development of a desktop application for MINSAP with the name RectSP. This system allows the control each prescription received at pharmacy. Developed on C#, Entity Framework as ORM and Microsoft SQL Server as database system.
- Worked on design & development of a web application for CUVENPETROL S.A with the name PDCuven. This system allows the control and maintenance of all the work machinery. Built with PHP-5, Symfony-2.4, Doctrine, Bootstrap, and Subversion; deployed with Apache and MySQL as database system.

positions.title: Software Programmer
positions.description:
- Worked on development of Academic System a web application. Developed with ASP.Net MVC, Bootstrap, JQuery, Entity Framework as ORM and Microsoft SQL Server as database system.
- Also, worked on development of SIGICEM web application built with PHP-5, Symfony 1.4, Propel, Subversion, and PostgreSQL as database system. This system allows the logistic management for medical technology.
